flashcard_questions.q: What is the ummah in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: The worldwide community of Muslim believers, united by shared faith.
Men and women having the same rights, opportunities and treatment in all areas of life.

flashcard_questions.q: What is prejudice, as distinct from discrimination?
flashcard_questions.a: Holding biased opinions about a person or group without good reason.

flashcard_questions.q: What is discrimination, as distinct from prejudice?
flashcard_questions.a: Treating someone unfairly because of a characteristic such as gender or race.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible verse says there is neither male nor female in Christ Jesus?
Which Qur’an verse promises equal spiritual reward to believing men and women?
What did St Paul write to wives in Ephesians 5:22?
flashcard_questions.a: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Bible verse says women should not teach or have authority over men?
What does Qur’an 4:34 say about the role of men?
flashcard_questions.a: Men are the protectors and maintainers of women.

flashcard_questions.q: How many wives does Qur’an 4:3 permit a Muslim man to have?
flashcard_questions.a: Up to four, provided each wife is treated equally.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the Qur’an admit about treating several wives fairly?
flashcard_questions.a: You will never be able to do perfect justice between wives.

flashcard_questions.q: When did the Church of England first ordain women as priests?
When did the Church of England first allow women to become bishops?
Why does the Catholic Church not ordain women as priests?
flashcard_questions.a: Jesus and his disciples were male, and long-standing Church tradition follows that pattern.

flashcard_questions.q: Which law makes gender discrimination illegal in the UK today?

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (ummah, gender equality, prejudice, discrimination), 5 belief→source (Galatians 3:28, Qur’an 33:35, Ephesians 5:22, 1 Timothy 2:12, Qur’an 4:34), 2 date cards (women priests 1994, women bishops 2014), 2 tradition→position (Catholic priesthood, Qur’an 4:3), 2 legal/qualifying facts. Built around gender roles so it does not duplicate the sister families lesson.
